name: Victorian Utility Relief Grant Scheme
provider: Victorian Department of Families, Fairness and Housing
summary: Grant to help Victorian Health Care Card holders and low-income households pay overdue electricity, gas or water bills.
key: You can receive a maximum of $650 on each utility type in a two-year period.
who: Account holders with a Pensioner Concession Card, Health Care Card or Veterans' Affairs Gold Card, or part of a low-income household
Must show you can't pay without help and are at risk of disconnection
how: Phone your electricity, gas or water retailer to request an application.
catches: The grant is based on the amount you owe when you apply.

source.label: DFFH Victoria: Utility relief grant scheme

evidence.quote: You can receive a maximum of $650 on each utility type in a two-year period
If you don’t have one of these cards but are part of a low-income household, you may also be able to apply.
